ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites: IE 510, ECE 490, or equivalent courses on introductory optimization. Mathematical optimization is a crucial component of modern machine learning. This course gives an overview of optimization theory and methods in deep learning, including algorithms, modeling and geometry. The goal is to demystify common optimization methods/tricks in deep learning. For algorithms, we discuss various popular methods such as initialization, BatchNorm, Adam, etc. For geometry, we discuss the optimization landscape of neural-network problems, which is closely related to the quality of the local minima. We also discuss how to formulate GANs, adversarial attacks, etc. from an optimization perspective.
